findings.source_quote: Give thanks and laud, for more is here!
findings.suggested_fix: Render the nuance of 'more is here' as an implication of additional grace/blessing rather than the literal 'more came'. Example fix (preserve tags): "धन्यवाद करो और स्तुति करो; और अधिक अनुग्रह यहाँ है!"
